source_basis.trainer: src/trainer/grpo_trainer_cl.py@2715d5f79fd45fcbc0f7e4155d82f2042042a358 uses mask.view(-1).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0] for flat indices and later boolean partition filtering
source_basis.mask_builder: src/compute_importance_mask.py@5f17be7ad91bdc162a0d1e466198c1bdb2ded921 stores reference weights by boolean mask indexing over the same flattened mask
source_basis.pytorch_2_8_docs: torch.nonzero returns lexicographically sorted indices; for the flattened 1-D mask this means ascending flat indices. torch.searchsorted supports lower-bound slicing of a sorted 1-D sequence.

test.coverage: random N=1..50000, world_size=1..32, support up to 50%, including non-divisible partitions and boundary hits

result.statement: Because CPO's flat protected indices are sorted and refs are aligned in the same flat-mask order, one-time ZeRO rank localization can use two CPU searchsorted bounds and a contiguous slice instead of materializing an O(s) in_partition boolean vector. The slice must be cloned before releasing the global idx/ref tensors; an ordinary slice shares storage and would otherwise pin the full global allocation.
safe_algorithm: ds_start = rank * partition_size; ds_end = min(ds_start + partition_size, ds_numel)
lo = searchsorted(flat_idx, ds_start, right=False); hi = searchsorted(flat_idx, ds_end, right=False)
release dense mask, global flat_idx and global ref only after shape/order/count checks pass
retain global_n_masked as the regularizer denominator; do not substitute hi-lo
result.view_lifetime_check: In the executed runtime, a plain tensor slice shares the original storage pointer while clone() does not; cloning is therefore required for actual steady-state memory release.

scope: Algorithmic/source-equivalent result. PyTorch 2.8 documentation supports sorted nonzero/searchsorted semantics, but the code has not yet been run under the public PyTorch 2.8 + DeepSpeed 0.16.4 runtime.
next_actions: Integrate searchsorted+clone rank localization into the source-equivalent load prototype with canonical trainer namespace and global denominator checks.
Fail closed if ds_numel/world_size/rank or canonical parameter identity differs from the tuple used to build the rank-local state.
Measure actual per-parameter support imbalance before choosing sparse index width and before treating s/W as a capacity estimate.
